values.meaning: delay before thicket snaps upward and knocks up enemies
values.quote: After 2 seconds, the thicket snaps upward

values.quote: dealing {{ft|150% damage per flurry.|75% damage per shot.}}

mechanics.claim: Plants hit by the thicket become enraged, gain increased size and refresh their duration while the thicket expands.
mechanics.quote: become enraged, restoring {{as|{{sti|health|50% of their '''current''' health}}}}, increasing their {{as|'''maximum''' health by 50%}}, gaining 25% increased [[size]] and refreshing their duration while the thicket expands.

mechanics.claim: Plants grown during the 2 seconds prior to the knock-up will also be enraged.
mechanics.quote: Plants grown during the 2 seconds prior to the displacement will also be enraged.

mechanics.claim: Plants already grown before cast have their duration refreshed if inside the area of effect.
mechanics.quote: Plants already grown before ''Stranglethorns'' is cast will have their duration refreshed if they are inside the area of effect.

mechanics.claim: Enraged plants attack in a flurry, launching two shots per attack instead of one.
mechanics.quote: attack in a flurry, launching two shots per attack, dealing {{ft|150% damage per flurry.|75% damage per shot.}}

mechanics.claim: The spell can be blocked by spell shields.
